name: coincident-cylinder-union
why: A cylinder unioned with itself turned about its axis: the fuse splits the side into two faces sharing one surface, and a pcurve is stored per surface, not per face. The seam-pcurve pre-pass before unify saw each piece use the old seam once and dropped a representation the other piece needed — BRepCheck invalid, B-rep volume 523.60 mm³ of 1570.80, 14 open mesh edges. It now keeps any seam another face on the same surface still borders. Holds the whole cylinder: 3 faces, 1570.80 mm³ exact, the same mesh as plain cylinder(5, 20).
